main_result: For A=A0+S+T and an original-coordinate cross cut I,J, define eta_r=s_{r+1}(S[I,J]) and rho=eta_r+delta for ||T||op<=delta. Then s_j(A[I,J])>=s_{r+j}(A0[I,J])-rho. D5 gives density <=5 sqrt(2e)(product_{j=1}^5(s_{r+j}(M0)-rho)_+)^{-1/5}. If s_{r+5}(M0)>=kappa>rho, density <=5 sqrt(2e)/(kappa-rho). S may have arbitrary global rank/norm/sign.
exact_family: Two 6-coordinate banks with cross block 2I6 plus k +2 spectator eigenvectors. Rotate g1 and the k spectators inside their degenerate +2 eigenspace to an arbitrary ONB z0..zk, then replace each eigenvalue 2 by 2+tau_a independently. The entire I-J update remains rank one. With any dense tail ||T||op<=1/4, D5 gives 6.661839947420355... uniformly in k and all tau_a; six untouched -2 eigenvalues keep the exact target hypothesis.
partner_application: On H={e2,f2,e3,f3}, the hostile update vanishes and the baseline has four eigenvalues of modulus 2. Partner compression stability gives density <=2 sqrt(24 pi)/(2-delta), equal to 9.923674348227669... at delta=1/4.
unresolved_implication: From bare s3(A)>=1, force either an original-coordinate cut with five-direction reserve after a bounded numerical-rank hostile cross footprint is spent, a bounded protected compression of partner type, or an already-paid volume/hub/ridge/grouped-bank/pair/triple/Schur exit.
next_step: Try to extract cross numerical-rank reserve from the low-pivot/no-pivot survivor, or prove a counterexample to that extraction while routing it into a grouped-bank or ridge certificate.
continuity: D5 branch continuous by L1 Fourier inversion; partner compression branch continuity not claimed separately.
